name: Spectra Wood Showroom
old_description: As we enter into our 45th year, we remain confident that building quality solid wood furniture of great value, good design, and practical use will endure the test of time. We hope that our website will be a valuable source of information and inspiration when purchasing Home or Contract Furnishings.
about:
Spectra Wood Showroom operates a factory showroom in State College, Pennsylvania. The company describes itself as entering its 45th year of business, though a specific founding year is not published. Ownership structure and founder names are not disclosed in public materials.

The firm manufactures solid wood furniture for both residential and contract markets. Product lines span bedroom, dining, home office, and occasional collections, with components such as solid wood tops, drawer fronts, rails, and exposed parts joined using wood-to-wood gluing reinforced with screws. The facility houses a factory showroom, suggesting integrated production and display, but square footage, headcount, and annual volume are not specified.

Spectra Wood serves home furnishings retailers and contract buyers, including commercial and hospitality projects. The website lists a “Find a Retailer” function and a dedicated Contract Sales channel, indicating a dual go-to-market approach. Specific client names or project references are not provided.

The company emphasizes domestic manufacturing and a design philosophy centered on quality, value, and practical use. It also offers customization options and a product warranty, though details are not elaborated in the available sources.
